info.title: MECHWARE Core Commerce API
info.description: Enterprise C# .NET 10 Web API for MECHWARE Industrial Commerce & Factory Automation

post.summary: Refuses a registration (wrong or someone else's BIN, failed documents) and frees its BIN for the real owner.

get.summary: Payments holding money that must go back, and refunds not finished yet.
Staff who must use an authenticator and have none yet, so the console can offer them a setup code.

post.summary: Creates an approval request if a rule matches; otherwise answers `approvalRequired: false`.
Staff enrolling their first authenticator: the token from password + setup code, and the first code.

get.summary: Companies that invited me and that I have not answered yet.

post.summary: Places an order. The `Idempotency-Key` header is required: retrying a request with the same key and body returns the first order.
Cancels the caller's own order while it is still pending.
Starts paying the caller's pending order. The amount is the order's own total; it cannot be chosen here.

The provider's server-to-server notification. Anonymous by nature: its authority is the signature, which is checked
over the exact raw body, so the body is read as text rather than bound to a model.

get.summary: Searches products by free text or part number, with brand, category, stock, price and numeric-attribute (`attr=code:min..max`) filters. A value with a unit in the text ("750 W") matches by measure.
Title suggestions for a prefix, at most 10.

Looks a manufacturer part number up, written any way ("6ES7 214-1AG40-0XB0" = "6es72141ag400xb0"). A query string, not a
path segment: part numbers contain '/' and '.'. 200 with the matches (`exact` false means "did you mean"), 404 when
none, 400 when fewer than two letters or digits are left.

A datasheet, CAD model or certificate of a published product. Always a download (never shown in the page), with the type we
detected when it was uploaded, not one the client chose. Anything else, including a product that is not published, is a 404.
Product detail page payload. Retired slugs answer 301 to the current slug.
Brands that have at least one published product, by name; labels for the brand facet slugs.
Products in a category and all of its descendants, best sellers first.

PlaceOrderBody.description:
What the buyer asks for: items and quantities, and which saved address or company site to deliver to. Every price,
tax, discount, total and the address text itself are the server's own; other JSON members are not bound and are ignored.

Bearer.description: Enter JWT Bearer token to authorize requests: Bearer {token}
